citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
Upon review of the Program of Veterinary Care (PVC), APHIS Officials asked the facility if they were doing fecal testing
and oral swabs monthly as prescribed by the PVC. The facility stated that they were not doing monthly tests as
prescribed. APHIS Officials called the Attending Veterinarian to confirm the tests prescribed were an active protocol and
the AV confirmed, the birds should be getting monthly fecal and oral swabs. The facility must follow the PVC as written by
the Attending Veterinarian and use of appropriate methods to prevent, control, diagnose, and treat diseases and injuries,
and the availability of emergency, weekend, and holiday care.
Correct from today forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Facility Representative.
Additional Inspectors:
Patricia Laracuente, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
